notes: Session Law 2023-134 sets the rate at 3.99% for taxable years after 2025 (4.25% in 2025); further cuts may apply from 2027 if revenue triggers are met.
NC standard deduction is set by statute (not indexed): $12,750 single, $25,500 MFJ, $19,125 HOH; it is zero if the taxpayer is not eligible for the federal standard deduction.
Child deduction (by AGI), NC itemized deductions, and NC additions/deductions such as the bonus-depreciation add-back are not modeled.
NC has no personal exemption and few individual credits (e.g., credit for taxes paid to other states); not modeled.

seDeduction.note: North Carolina starts from federal AGI, which already reflects the deductible half of SE tax; no NC add-back.

seHealthInsurance.note: Inherited through federal AGI; no NC add-back.

retirementContributions.note: SEP/solo 401(k) deductions in federal AGI flow through.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is below the AGI line, so it is not part of NC's starting point.

localIncomeTax.note: North Carolina counties and cities do not levy income taxes.

estimatedTax.threshold: Tax shown due on the return, after NC withholding and allowable credits, of $1,000 or more
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Interest applies unless withholding plus timely estimates equal the lesser of 90% of the current-year tax (66 2/3% farmers/fishermen) or 100% of the prior-year tax (prior year must be a 12-month return). No interest if there was no tax liability for the prior year.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $125 Articles of Organization (NC Secretary of State).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $200 annual report, due April 15 each year beginning the year after formation.
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for LLCs (NC franchise tax applies to C and S corporations, including LLCs electing corporate taxation).
